title: Sliding-Window Detection of Hidden Regimes under Stochastic Switching
abstract: arXiv:2611.34905v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A sliding-window average is a simple estimator of the current state of a hidden regime-switching process, such as a hidden Markov model. A longer window averages out more noise but is more likely to contain a switch, and the question is what such a switch costs. We analyse the decoder that assigns the average of the last $m$ observations to the nearest regime mean. For two regimes with conditionally independent, stochastically ordered observations, a switch inside the window, averaged uniformly over its positions and directions, causes an error with probability exactly $1/2$. Consequently, for every stationary switching law, the error is at most $\bar P(m)+\bar s(m-1)/2$, where $\bar P(m)$ is the stationary-weighted single-regime error and $\bar s$ the switch rate. translated_title: 随机切换下隐藏状态的滑动窗口检测
translated_abstract: 滑动窗口平均是估计隐藏状态切换过程（如隐马尔可夫模型）当前状态的一种简单方法。较长的窗口能平均掉更多噪声，但更可能包含一次状态切换，问题在于这种切换的代价有多大。我们分析了将最近 m 个观测值的平均值归入最近状态均值的解码器。对于两个具有条件独立、随机有序观测的状态，窗口内发生的一次切换（对其位置和方向进行均匀平均后）恰好以 1/2 的概率导致分类错误。因此，对于任意平稳切换律，错误概率至多为 $\bar P(m)+\bar s(m-1)/2$，其中 $\bar P(m)$ 是平稳加权的单状态错误率，$\bar s$ 是切换率。在马尔可夫切换下，通过时间反演可以证明：只要窗口内最旧状态与当前状态不同，该窗口就会以恰好 1/2 的概率被错误分类，而与窗口内切换次数无关……
tldr: 该论文证明了对随机切换的隐藏状态过程，滑动窗口内发生状态切换时错误概率恰好为 1/2，由此得到解码错误的上界为单状态错误率与切换率贡献之和。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a regime switch inside a sliding window causes misclassification with probability exactly 1/2, yielding the error bound P̄(m) + s̄(m−1)/2 for nearest-mean sliding-window decoding of hidden regime-switching processes.
